A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Lumos research work. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and complete appendices F–J are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original image-generation, novel-view-synthesis, and video-generation results, alongside main-text and supplementary ablations.

after.justification: V3 retains those original experiments and additionally reports Lumos results on DPG-Bench in Table 3.

M1.justification: The image-conditioned diffusion framework, frozen encoders, training objectives, and transfer procedures for text-to-image, novel-view synthesis, and video generation are unchanged. The supplementary method details are also retained.

E1.justification: V3 adds DPG-Bench evaluation, extending text-image alignment coverage to dense prompts and relationships between entities. Existing training datasets, benchmarks, and generation tasks remain.

E2.justification: Table 3 adds LUMINA-Next and Playground v2.5 to the GenEval comparison. Existing comparator sets in the other experiments are retained; extending existing methods to DPG-Bench is a separate coverage addition.

E3.justification: The added DPG-Bench evaluation introduces Global, Entity, Attribute, Relation, Other, and aggregate Average scores. Retained experiments have no substantive documented setting changes; Table S1 changes multiplication and exponent typography without changing values.

E4.justification: The prior, conditioning-feature, vision-encoder, text-encoder, and guidance ablations are retained with unchanged plots. Appendix F preserves the motivation, condition-token, and encoder-scale analyses.

E5.justification: Existing statistical reporting and training curves are retained. The added Table 3 results use point scores without introducing repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 3 adds DPG-Bench results, including Lumos's Average score of 79.9, and GenEval results for two additional comparators. Existing scores remain unchanged, including Lumos's GenEval 0.57 and COCO FIDs 12.20 and 6.44. The main qualitative gallery drops the Bentley and wolf examples.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(2) and supplementary objectives (S1)–(S2) retain the same mathematical content. No new assumptions, theoretical results, proofs, or substantive derivations appear.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims about scalable visual pretraining without text, comparable or better T2I performance using one-tenth the text-image pairs, and advantages for text-irrelevant generation tasks.

C2.justification: V3 interprets the added dense-prompt evaluation as further support for I2I pretraining followed by T2I alignment. It removes the explicit explanation that SyncDreamer is restricted to 30-degree elevation, although Table 4 retains missing entries at zero degrees. The principal mechanism explanations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The project URL is updated. Section 4.2.1 removes v1's explicit statement that a multimodal language model generates long captions for MS-COCO evaluation, while retaining the long-caption results. Appendix G–H preserves dataset filtering, hardware, optimizer, and training-stage details.

R1.justification: V3 adds references to ELLA, the cited source for DPG-Bench, Playground v2.5, and Lumina-Next. The related-work discussion and the method's positioning relative to earlier generative approaches remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: Experimental paragraphs are tightened and rewritten, ablation headings are standardized, author and affiliation text changes, and acknowledgments are added. The main section sequence and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 3 expands into grouped GenEval and DPG-Bench columns. Main figures and tables are resized or relocated, and the T2I gallery changes from ten examples in v1 Figure 4 to eight in v3 Figure 6. Supplementary displays remain essentially unchanged.

improvement.justification: The dense-prompt evaluation and additional GenEval comparators in Table 3 provide a useful complementary check of text-image alignment, modestly strengthening empirical support. The method and earlier evidence are preserved. This gain is partly offset by less explicit documentation of COCO evaluation-caption generation and the removed explanation of SyncDreamer's elevation restriction.
